== Overview ==

NoxiousOT is a free to play massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG). Complete challenging quests, fight in massive PvP guild battles and much more. An epic adventure awaits! Hosted in USA and based off the 8.6 Tibia Client. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.
